translations.web: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
translations.bsb: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell down before Him trembling in fear, and she told Him the whole truth.
translations.kjv: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
